title: A Map at the Pit
lines: A map is at the pit!
Tim and Pam sit at the map.

questions.listenFor: A map. It is in the second line. Point at the line rather than saying it.

questions.ask: Who sits at the map at the end?
questions.listenFor: Tim and Pam. The last line names them both.

questions.ask: What would you do with a map? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer. Listen for a reason of their own.
